resources.string: Find music for the atmosphere you want. Open the official platform and keep your discoveries here.
No photo is uploaded when you choose or cancel.

Recipient: %1$s
Model: %2$s

This app sends a resized image with metadata removed through your configured service. The service sends it to the model provider. Neither the app nor this service stores the photo. Provider retention follows its account policy; store=false does not mean zero retention.

You can refuse and use manual input.
Real photo analysis is blocked: no authorized live model. Manual discovery is available.
Choose a scene and your music intent. No photo is required.
Request cancelled. You can edit and try again.
No new matching tracks. Try other search words, a different country, or clear hidden tracks.
Your Collection is empty. Save a discovery to keep its source and your music intent.
Cannot reach the discovery service. Check its address and connection, then retry. Manual input and saved discoveries remain available.
Check the music intent. Use plain search words up to 160 characters, without URLs.
Enter an HTTPS service address. Debug builds also allow localhost, 127.0.0.1 or 10.0.2.2.
Photo analysis was not completed. Use manual input or select a supported JPEG, PNG or WebP image up to 5 MiB and 20 megapixels.
Collection could not be read or saved. Existing data was retained. Reopen the app to retry.
Collection is full (200 saved tracks / 300 hidden tracks). Remove entries before adding more.
No app or browser can open this link. Install or enable a browser.
This track has no valid official link.
The service is unavailable, busy or rate limited. Please retry later; no substitute songs were added.
Hidden tracks cleared. Saved tracks remain excluded from new discoveries.
Photo suggestions are ready. Your current choices are unchanged; use the suggestion button to apply them.
Official links can depend on your region or platform account. In-app preview is planned for Sprint 4.
Service connected. Confirm your music intent to discover.
Check the service to see catalog and photo model availability.
The service returned an invalid response. No unverified suggestions were added. Retry or use manual input.
Official link opened. Return here to save a discovery.
